title: The channel run by nobody (YouTube automation repo)
caption:
This channel posts every single day… and nobody works there 🤯

It's a free, open-source repo. 69,000 people starred it ⭐

1️⃣ You give it one topic
2️⃣ AI writes the script
3️⃣ A free stock clip for every line
4️⃣ Voice + subtitles + music
5️⃣ It makes 5 versions, you keep the best
🚀 It can even post to YouTube, Instagram, TikTok

But post junk every day and you get demonetized. One good topic a day is the real job.

Comment AUTO and I'll DM you the name + full setup 📩
